mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (session_id, user_id, role, sources, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{sources,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.JsonTypeHandler}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET session_id = #{sessionId}, user_id = #{userId}, role = #{role}, sources = #{sources,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.JsonTypeHandler}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, role, sources, content, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT id, session_id, user_id, role, sources, content, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, session_id, user_id, role, sources, content, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND role = #{role} ORDER BY created_at DESC
